service.description: What the picker opens with: the drives the user may open (FileServices.get#UserDrives, without storage sizes; the personal drive first, named My files), personalDriveId when that drive is among them, and the user's recent files (FileServices.find#Recent, at most recentLimit; none with includeRecent false). hasDrive is false when the user may open no drive at all (the screens then leave out Attach from Files and Save to Files). checkOnly answers hasDrive alone and writes nothing: a user with no personal drive yet has one (it is made when the picker opens), so only an archived one is looked further into.

A folder of a drive for the picker (FileServices.list#Folder): its files and folders, folders first, each with its fileType and icon (get#FileType), and the breadcrumbs from the drive's top. A folder the user may not open, or a path with "..", is "Folder not found".

parameter.name: fileList
parameter.description: {driveId, path, name, isDirectory, size, modified, fileType, icon}

parameter.name: canWrite
parameter.description: Whether the user may save into this folder

service.description: Files and folders by name across the drives the user may open (FileServices.find#Resources), newest first, at most limit: the picker's search. A blank text finds nothing.

parameter.name: fileList
parameter.description: {driveId, driveName, path, folderPath, name, isDirectory, size, modified, fileType, icon}

service.description: The kind of a file by its name, as FileServices names it (image, video, audio, pdf, spreadsheet, presentation, document, archive, text, other; folder for a folder), with the icon the picker shows for it.

actions.script: const text = String(name || '') const ext = text.includes('.') ? text.slice(text.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase() : '' const contentType = isDirectory ? '' : (ec.resource.contentTypeOf(text) || '') if (isDirectory) fileType = 'folder' else if (contentType.startsWith('image/')) fileType = 'image' else if (contentType.startsWith('video/')) fileType = 'video' else if (contentType.startsWith('audio/')) fileType = 'audio' else if (ext === 'pdf') fileType = 'pdf' else if (['xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', 'csv'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'spreadsheet' else if (['ppt', 'pptx', 'odp'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'presentation' else if (['doc', 'docx', 'odt', 'rtf'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'document' else if (['zip', 'gz', 'tgz', 'bz2', 'xz', '7z', 'rar', 'tar'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'archive' else if (contentType.startsWith('text/') || ['md', 'txt', 'json', 'xml', 'yaml', 'yml'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'text' else fileType = 'other' const icons = {folder: 'sym_o_folder', image: 'sym_o_image', video: 'sym_o_movie', audio: 'sym_o_music_note', pdf: 'sym_o_picture_as_pdf', spreadsheet: 'sym_o_table_chart', presentation: 'sym_o_slideshow', document: 'sym_o_article', archive: 'sym_o_folder_zip', text: 'sym_o_description', other: 'sym_o_draft'} icon = icons[fileType]
